verdict.rationale: MotherDuck is a serverless SQL data warehouse built on DuckDB, and community feedback praising Instant SQL's CTE inspection shows CTEs are supported in its SQL surface. Nothing in the pack documents window functions, JSON, arrays, date/time types, or whether these work without extensions. missing for 10: documented window function support, semi-structured JSON handling, array/list types, rich date/time types, confirmation that these are built in rather than extensions, independent corroboration of the broader analytical SQL surface.
